professionalSummary.text: Analytics engineer with three years of experience building and maintaining transformation models in a marketing data warehouse under a standardized framework, managing 90+ models through merge requests.
professionalSummary.witness: Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed marketing analysts' model contributions as one of two team reviewers, mentoring 11 analysts through onboarding sessions with documented review records and first merged contributions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran daily data quality checks and resolved failures under the data quality procedure, with failure logs documenting each resolution.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated model releases using a release checklist, recording own responsibilities and noting the analytics engineering lead's approval.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model limitations and hand-over conditions in each model's documentation page.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each model in its documentation page.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided work samples including two merge requests with review records, onboarding attendance log for 11 analysts, one week's data quality failure log, and a release checklist with approval, all with repository references for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two merge requests with review records, the onboarding attendance log with the analysts' first contributions, one week's data quality failure log and one release checklist with its approval, with the repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Proficient in building and maintaining transformation models under a standardized framework, reviewing model contributions, running data quality checks, coordinating model releases, and documenting model limitations.
skills.witness: Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name. Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding. Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution. Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine. Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each model in its documentation page.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with building and maintaining models, reviewing contributions, running data quality checks, coordinating releases, and documenting limitations. The materials do not establish the candidate's ability to mentor without being abrasive or their interpersonal skills in a team setting.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to interview notes suggesting potential interpersonal issues that could impact mentoring effectiveness.
